purpose: Prevent retired or compatibility-only repository surfaces from silently regaining primary authority while preserving history and required compatibility until deletion is proven safe.

tracked_surfaces.release_condition: Delete only after external consumer absence is proven and the compatibility regression/workflow is intentionally retired.
Do not delete the file while the successor runtime is implemented here. Retire only the deprecated endpoint after consumer absence is proven.

retired_public_symbols.release_condition: Historical/internal compatibility references may be removed only after data migration and consumer-absence evidence. They must not reappear as public plans or public commercial CTAs.
